title: "Get started"

## Installation

Python 3.10 or later is required.

```bash
uv add "pypanelsim @ git+ssh://git@github.com/apoorvalal/pypanelsim.git"
```

For a local checkout:

```bash
uv sync
```

For this documentation site, including crabbymetrics, PyFixest, Jupyter, and
pandas:

```bash
uv sync --extra docs
```

## One canonical draw

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pypanelsim as pps

panel = pps.classic_factor(overlap=1.0, seed=42)
print(panel.name, panel.shape, panel.true_att)
```

Every panel contains the observed outcome, treatment, untreated potential
outcome, and realized treatment effect:

```{python}
np.testing.assert_allclose(
    panel.outcome,
    panel.untreated_outcome + panel.treatment_effect,
)
print(panel.is_absorbing)
print(panel.adoption_times[:5], panel.adoption_times[-5:])
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "A canonical factor-panel draw. Controls precede the common treated cohort."
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.8), constrained_layout=True)
axes[0].matshow(panel.outcome, aspect="auto", cmap="coolwarm")
axes[1].matshow(panel.treatment, aspect="auto", cmap="Greys", vmin=0, vmax=1)
axes[0].set_title("Observed outcome Y")
axes[1].set_title("Treatment W")
for axis in axes:
    axis.set_xlabel("period")
    axis.set_ylabel("unit")
plt.show()
```

## Estimator interchange

Wide NumPy arrays:

```{python}
y, w = panel.as_arrays()
print(y.shape, w.shape, y.flags.writeable)
```

Long columns:

```{python}
import pandas as pd

long = pd.DataFrame(dict(panel.as_long_dict()))
long.head()
```

Pass `copy=True` when a downstream estimator mutates its inputs.

## Repeated simulations

`iter_simulations()` spawns independent child seed sequences:

```{python}
simulator = pps.classic_factor_design(overlap=1.0)
draws = list(simulator.iter_simulations(3, seed=2026))
print([draw.true_att for draw in draws])
print(np.array_equal(draws[0].outcome, draws[1].outcome))
```

## Custom dimensions

```{python}
config = pps.CanonicalPanelConfig(
    n_control=40,
    n_treated=10,
    n_pre=20,
    n_post=5,
    effect_slope=0.15,
    noise_variance=0.25,
)
small = pps.synthetic_control(config=config, active_share=0.2, seed=7)
print(small.shape, small.true_att)
```
